core_obligations: Implication (1) implies (2) (proof lines 12829-12836): for an object U there is a covering over which E is represented by a strictly perfect complex, so E is pseudo-coherent by locality, and since a direct summand of a finite free module is flat the local models have finite tor dimension.

Implication (2) implies (1) (proof lines 12838-12844): after passing to a covering there are integers a <= b such that E|_U has tor amplitude in [a, b]; as E|_U is m-pseudo-coherent for all m, the precise criterion makes E|_U perfect, and by locality E is perfect.
proof_roadmap: Read pseudo-coherence and finite tor dimension off a strictly perfect local model.
Conversely, localise, bound the tor amplitude, and apply the precise criterion for perfection.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the equivalence between perfection and pseudo-coherence together with locally finite tor dimension (statement lines 12817-12826). The proof (proof lines 12828-12844) reads the two properties off a strictly perfect local model for one direction, and applies the precise criterion for perfection after bounding the tor amplitude locally for the other. H2: two short local arguments.
